messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the person's identity to match the person in the reference photo. Use the reference photo only to determine the target person's facial identity and skin tone. Apply that skin tone consistently to the face and body. Retain the current hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, action, scene, and camera.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please change the person's identity to match the person in the reference photo. Only use the reference photo to determine the target person's facial identity and skin tone. Apply that skin tone consistently to the face and body, while retaining the current hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, action, scene, and camera.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"She begins standing still facing forward, then turns and raises her hand to brush her hair back while turning her back to the camera, then turns back to face forward.","camera":"The camera is at a low, wide angle and slowly pushes in closer to the subject over the duration of the clip.","clothing":"She wears a white off-the-shoulder top with puffed sleeves, a pink-and-white gingham corset-style midsection, a black-and-white asymmetrical skirt, and light blue sneakers.","hair_color":"Her hair is a vivid red color.","hairstyle":"Her hair is pulled up into a high bun or topknot.","identity":"A 3D-rendered woman with dark skin and a slim build stands in the center of the frame.","scene":"The setting is an outdoor amusement park at dusk, with a large Ferris wheel, a ticket booth, and a roller coaster visible in the background under a pink and orange sky."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The output remains visually almost identical to the source: same 3D woman, dark skin, red topknot, white/pink/black outfit, amusement park scene, and same turning/brushing-hair action. No clear facial identity change toward the reference person is visible.
arguments.requested_change: Change the person's facial identity and skin tone to match the reference photo, applying the reference skin tone consistently to face and body while retaining hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, action, scene, and camera.
uncertain: Subtle facial identity differences are hard to judge from the low-resolution frames, but no obvious match to the reference face is visible.
unexpected_changes: The output appears to have a slightly different aspect ratio or framing, with black bars visible at the top and bottom in some frames.
